entities.summary: Roman Bilyk (b. 1977-12-07, Taganrog) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Taganrog and Russia. Known in the fields of russia, composers & musicians, europe.
